cards.a: Std-IA min 30d, Glacier Instant Retrieval min 90d, Deep Archive min 180d. Early transition still bills the full minimum.

cards.q: Spot instances — right vs wrong workloads?
cards.a: Right: stateless, fault-tolerant, batch, distributed, ASG mixed instances. Wrong: stateful DBs, SPOFs, can't survive 2-min interruption notice.
Savings Plans: commit $/hr, flexible across family/size/OS/region. RIs: commit to instance attributes + capacity reservation option. Both 1-3yr, ~30-72% off.

cards.q: When is Aurora Serverless v2 the exam answer?
cards.a: Unpredictable/infrequent DB load, dev/test, multi-tenant SaaS, no capacity planning — fine-grained scaling (vs v1's on/off ACUs).
